Our process

From enquiry to delivery, in five steps.

01

Create Order

Contact us, give the requirements and the type of goods to be transported. Get a quote and total order details.

02

Select Supplier

From the available range of suppliers — or your own supplier — must be chosen and fixed for transportation.

03

Select Cargo

Select the type of shipment or cargo, which depends on the time frame goods are to be transported. Be it sea — find your best suitable freight.

04

Complete Transaction

Make the payment and complete the transaction. Now your goods' safety is our concern, and we'll make sure the needful is done.

05

Shipping

Your consignments are shipped through the selected freight to the said location, within stipulated time, with complete safety and security.
